title: Parker modeled his alto on Smith at Lucia's Paradise
summary: Parker copied Smith's double-time by ear without asking him anything.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Now, when Charlie Parker was with you in the little band that you had in '38, what was the name of the club you were working at?
Was he literally modeling himself on you? He'd try to do these double-time things that you would do?
And in between gigs or in between sets, would he ever ask and say, 'What is it exactly you're doing here?' Would you show him things?
No, not that way. He just listened, and come up behind me and do the same thing I do.
He had such great ears he could just do it like that.

Yeah! He'd pick up on... He'd react that way. He didn't ask you to show him nothin'. You make it, he'll make it too. Yeah, he was just a natural-born alto player. Yeah. He didn't jam too much down there at them big clubs where all them cats were down...
